source.content: public class AuthProviderShape extends Auth.AuthProviderPluginClass { public override PageReference initiate(Map<String,String> config, String state) { return new PageReference('/login'); } public override Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse handleCallback(Map<String,String> config, Auth.AuthProviderCallbackState state) { return new Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse('provider', 'token', 'secret', state.body); } public override Auth.UserData getUserInfo(Map<String,String> config, Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse response) { return new Auth.UserData('id', 'first', 'last', 'full', 'email@example.invalid', 'link', 'user', response.provider, 'en_US', 'site', new Map<String,String>()); } public override String getCustomMetadataType() { return 'Auth_Config__mdt'; } public override Auth.OAuthRefreshResult refresh(Map<String,String> config, String refreshToken) { return new Auth.OAuthRefreshResult('access', refreshToken); } }

public class AuthApprovalShapeProbe { public void compileShape() { Auth.AuthConfiguration cfg = new Auth.AuthConfiguration('https://community.example.invalid', '/start'); Boolean internalLogin = cfg.getAllowInternalUserLoginEnabled(); Object authConfig = cfg.getAuthConfig(); List<Auth.AuthConfig> providers = cfg.getAuthConfigProviders(); Object authProviders = cfg.getAuthProviders(); Object background = cfg.getBackgroundColor(); String sso = Auth.AuthConfiguration.getAuthProviderSsoUrl('provider', '/start', 'site'); String domain = Auth.AuthConfiguration.getAuthProviderSsoDomainUrl('provider', '/start', 'site'); Boolean certEnabled = cfg.getCertificateLoginEnabled('site'); String certUrl = Auth.AuthConfiguration.getCertificateLoginUrl('site', '/start'); String profile = cfg.getDefaultProfileForRegistration(); Object footer = cfg.getFooterText(); Object forgot = cfg.getForgotPasswordUrl(); Boolean headless = cfg.getHeadlessPasswordlessLoginEnabled() || cfg.getHeadlessRegistrationEnabled() || cfg.getHeadlessForgotPasswordEnabled() || cfg.getHeadlessFrgtPswEnabled(); Object loginRight = cfg.getLoginRightFrameUrl(); String logo = cfg.getLogoUrl(); List<Auth.AuthConfig> saml = cfg.getSamlProviders(); String samlUrl = Auth.AuthConfiguration.getSamlSsoUrl('provider', '/start', 'site'); Boolean selfReg = cfg.getSelfRegistrationEnabled(); String selfUrl = cfg.getSelfRegistrationUrl(); Object start = cfg.getStartUrl(); Boolean userPass = cfg.getUsernamePasswordEnabled(); Boolean siteContainer = cfg.isCommunityUsingSiteAsContainer(); Auth.AuthProviderCallbackState callback = new Auth.AuthProviderCallbackState(new Map<String,String>{'h' => 'v'}, 'body', new Map<String,String>{'q' => 'v'}); String body = callback.body; Map<String,String> headers = callback.headers; Map<String,String> query = callback.queryParameters; Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse token = new Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse('provider', 'oauth', 'refresh', 'state'); token.idToken = 'id'; Auth.GeneratedUserData generated = new Auth.GeneratedUserData('first', 'last', 'email@example.invalid', 'user', 'alias', 'en_US', 'America/Los_Angeles', 'UTF-8', 'en_US'); Auth.HeadlessUserDiscoveryResponse discovery = new Auth.HeadlessUserDiscoveryResponse(new Set<Id>(), 'message'); Auth.TokenValidationResult validation = new Auth.TokenValidationResult(false); Auth.VerificationAction action = null; Auth.VerificationPolicy policy = null; Auth.InvocationContext invocation = new Auth.InvocationContext(); Auth.IntegratingAppType appType = null; Auth.OAuth2TokenExchangeType exchangeType = null; Auth.OauthTokenType tokenType = null; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest submit = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); submit.setComments('comment'); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest work = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); work.setAction('Approve'); System.assert(internalLogin == false || userPass == true || headless == false || certEnabled == false || selfReg == false || sso != null || domain != null || certUrl != null || profile != null || logo != null || samlUrl != null || selfUrl != null || providers != null || saml != null || body != null || headers != null || query != null || token.provider != null || generated.email != null || discovery.customErrorMessage != null || validation.isValid == false || action != null || policy != null || invocation != null || appType != null || exchangeType != null || tokenType != null || submit != null || work != null); } }
